reason: Canonical plain (non-secret) environment key set for every function in the codebase. Firebase deploys one dotenv file per project to every targeted function, so this is a global contract, not a per-function one. The 2026-10-13 P0-1 deploy found the gitignored functions/.env.seolleyeon-final holding 12 of the 31 live keys; deploying it would have removed 19 variables (the 2026-09-08 incident class). The guarded wrapper refuses a dotenv whose key set differs from this manifest. Values are never recorded here; secrets stay in Secret Manager (defineSecret) and must never appear as plain keys.
